ns2:course.label: Seminar in Design
ns2:course.description: Investigation of special problems and current topics in industrial and/or graphic design. Students will conduct original research which will be shared through papers, presentations, and discussions. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 16 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design or consent of instructor.
